parts.text: Copper is element 29 in the Periodic Table.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Copper can be stretched into wires. Copper wires conduct electricity.

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Copper is a transition element. Some physical and chemical properties of transition elements are shown. physical properties: ● high density ● high strength chemical properties: ● form coloured compounds ● have ions with variable oxidation numbers

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Hydrated copper( II ) sulfate is a coloured compound. It exists as hydrated crystals which contain water molecules.

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Copper( II ) oxide is formed when copper( II ) nitrate, Cu(NO 3 ) 2 , is heated. 2Cu(NO 3 ) 2 (s) → 2CuO(s) + 4NO 2 (g) + O 2 (g)

ms.label: 4(e)(ii)
ms.text: the oxidation number of copper is +2

parts.label: iii
